scope: credential-free model catalog drift review impact

behavior.metadataChanged: true only when the verified source revision changes
behavior.modelSetChanged: true when verified model identifiers are added or removed
behavior.modelStructureChanged: true when a retained model changes kind, adapter or schema
behavior.affectedModelCount: distinct added, removed or structurally changed model identifiers

invariants: unchanged reports expose all false flags and zero affected models
source-revision-only drift does not claim model impact
review impact is derived from verified snapshots and deeply immutable
all observed drift remains review_required and failClosed
